[Intro]
[ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]D[/ch]


[Verse]
[tab]       [ch]Em[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]                          [ch]D[/ch]
I am a lighthouse, worn by the weather and the waves.[/tab]
[tab]         [ch]Em[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]                         [ch]D[/ch]
I keep my lamp lit, to warn the sailors on their way.[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]Em[/ch]      [ch]G[/ch]                           [ch]D[/ch]
I'll tell a story, paint you a picture from my past.[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]Em[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]                       [ch]D[/ch]
I was so happy, but joy in this life seldom lasts.[/tab]


[Instrumental Break]
[ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]D[/ch]


[Verse]
[tab]        [ch]Em[/ch]         [ch]G[/ch]                           [ch]D[/ch]
I had a keeper, he helped me warn the ships at sea.[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]Em[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]                             [ch]D[/ch]
We had grown closer, 'till his joy meant everything to me.[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]Em[/ch]          [ch]G[/ch]                              [ch]D[/ch]
And he was to marry, a girl who shone with beauty and light.[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]Em[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]                                [ch]D[/ch]
And they loved each other, and with me watched the sunsets into night.[/tab]


[Chorus]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]                     [ch]Bm[/ch]       [ch]Bb[/ch]           [ch]C[/ch]    [ch]D[/ch]
And the waves crashing around me, the sand slips out to sea.[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]                      [ch]Bm[/ch]               [ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]F#m[/ch]    [ch]G[/ch]    [ch]A[/ch]              [ch]D[/ch]
And the winds that blow remind me, of what has been,          and what can never be.[/tab]


[Instrumental Break]
[ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]D[/ch]


[Verse]
[tab]             [ch]Em[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]                           [ch]D[/ch]
She'd had to leave us, my keeper he prayed for a safe return.[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]Em[/ch]              [ch]G[/ch]                             [ch]D[/ch]         [ch]C[/ch]
But when the night came, the weather to a raging storm had turned.[/tab]
[tab]               [ch]Em[/ch]                  [ch]G[/ch]                                  [ch]D[/ch]
He watched her ship fight, but in vain against the wild and terrible wave.[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]Em[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]                                  [ch]D[/ch]
In me so helpless, as dashed against the rock she met her end.[/tab]


[Chorus]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]                     [ch]Bm[/ch]       [ch]Bb[/ch]           [ch]C[/ch]    [ch]D[/ch]
And the waves crashing around me, the sand slips out to sea.[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]                      [ch]Bm[/ch]               [ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]F#m[/ch]    [ch]G[/ch]              [ch]A[/ch]      [ch]D[/ch]
And the winds that blow remind me, of what has been,          and what can never be.[/tab]


[Instrumental Break]
[ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]D[/ch]


[Verse]
[tab]           [ch]Em[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]                                 [ch]D[/ch]
Then on the next day, my keeper found her washed up on the shore.[/tab]
[tab]            [ch]Em[/ch]               [ch]G[/ch]                             [ch]D[/ch]
He kissed her cold face, that they'd be together soon he'd swore.[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]Em[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]                             [ch]D[/ch]
I saw him crying, watched as he buried her in the sand.[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]Em[/ch]                      [ch]G[/ch]                        [ch]D[/ch]
And then he climbed my tower, and off of the edge of me he ran.[/tab]


[Chorus]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]                     [ch]Bm[/ch]       [ch]Bb[/ch]           [ch]C[/ch]    [ch]D[/ch]
And the waves crashing around me, the sand slips out to sea.[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]                      [ch]Bm[/ch]               [ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]F#m[/ch]    [ch]G[/ch]              [ch]A[/ch]      [ch]D[/ch]
And the winds that blow remind me, of what has been,          and what can never be.[/tab]


[Instrumental Break]
[ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]D[/ch]


[tab]       [ch]Em[/ch]          [ch]G[/ch]                            [ch]D[/ch]
I am a lighthouse, worn by the weather and the waves.[/tab]
[tab]              [ch]Em[/ch]              [ch]G[/ch]                          [ch]D[/ch]
And though I'm empty, I still warn the sailors on their way.[/tab]
